message: docs: add note about 1.0 to README
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 3936fde..6c99853 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@
 
 <!-- TOC depthfrom:2 depthto:3 -->
 
+- [Release](#release)
 - [Introduction](#introduction)
 - [Help](#help)
   - [Help as a user of a Kong application](#help-as-a-user-of-a-kong-application)
@@ -42,6 +43,12 @@
 
 <!-- /TOC -->
 
+## Version 1.0.0 Release
+
+Kong has been stable for a long time, so it seemed appropriate to cut a 1.0 release.
+
+There is one breaking change, #436, which should effect relatively few users.
+
 ## Introduction
 
 Kong aims to support arbitrarily complex command-line structures with as little developer effort as possible.
@@ -554,7 +561,7 @@ Tags can be in two forms:
 Both can coexist with standard Tag parsing.
 
 | Tag                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
-|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
+| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
 | `cmd:""`             | If present, struct is a command.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
 | `arg:""`             | If present, field is an argument. Required by default.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
 | `env:"X,Y,..."`      | Specify envars to use for default value. The envs are resolved in the declared order. The first value found is used.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

explanation.what: README.md に "Version 1.0.0 Release" という節を新設し、TOC にもエントリを追加した。本文では「kong は長らく安定していたので 1.0 リリースを切るのが適切だと考えた」旨と、破壊的変更が #436(passthrough 引数に -- を含める変更、seq386)の1件のみで影響ユーザーは少ないはずだと明記している。あわせてタグ一覧表の区切り行のハイフン数を GitHub Flavored Markdown の慣習的な書式に揃えている。
explanation.why: v1.0.0 という節目のリリースにあたり、利用者向けに何が変わったか(破壊的変更が1件のみであること)を明文化するためのドキュメント追加。
